cves.d: The User Registration & Membership – Free & Paid Memberships, Subscriptions, Content Restriction, User Profile, Custom User Registration & Login Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Checkbox Field Value in all versions up to, and including, 5.2.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The nopriv AJAX action user_registration_user_form_submit reaches ur_process_registration() without nonce validation, meaning any unauthenticated request can reach the vulnerable code path.
vp: user registration & membership – free & paid memberships, subscriptions, content restriction, user profile, custom user registration & login builder

cves.d: The Themify Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'visible' Shortcode Attribute in all versions up to, and including, 7.8.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is only exploitable when the 'slider' custom post type is active, which is satisfied automatically when the plugin is paired with a Themify theme or any other plugin that registers the 'slider' CPT.

The Themify Popup plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'popup_width_unit' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

The EU VAT Assistant for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'vat_number' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.1.30.260413 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The stored payload executes in the administrator's browser context when reviewing an order via WooCommerce → Orders → Edit Order, enabling privilege escalation up to and including full site takeover via rogue administrator account creation.

The Payment forms, Buy now buttons, and Invoicing System | GetPaid plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'mmdwqzpoxadd' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.61 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The required nonce (getpaid_form_nonce) is publicly emitted to all visitors via wp_localize_script as WPInv.formNonce, meaning no authentication or prior nonce leak is needed; the stored payload fires when an administrator views the affected invoice's Payment Form Details metabox.
vp: payment forms, buy now buttons, and invoicing system | getpaid

cves.d: The YMC Filter plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_title' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.12.19 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The autocomplete REST endpoint is registered with a permission callback that unconditionally returns true, meaning any site visitor — including unauthenticated users — can trigger the payload simply by typing in the YMC filter search box, while only Author-level access is required to store it.

The European VAT Compliance Assistant for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via CF-IPCountry Header in all versions up to, and including, 1.36.10 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The malicious header value is persisted verbatim into order post-meta during a guest checkout, meaning no account or authentication is required to plant the payload.
vp: european vat compliance assistant for woocommerce

cves.d: The BSK PDF Manager WordPress plugin through 3.8.1 does not properly sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement, which could allow authenticated users with contributor-level access and above to perform SQL injection attacks and read sensitive data such as administrator password hashes from the database.

The Contact Form 7 Signature Addon WordPress plugin through 4.2.2 does not sanitize a signature field value before building an email attachment path from it, allowing unauthenticated users to attach arbitrary files (bounded to wp-content on current Contact Form 7) to a form's outgoing email via path traversal; when a form is configured to email a copy to a submitter-controlled address, the attacker can read the targeted file.

The Patreon WordPress plugin before 1.10.0 does not verify a nonce when connecting the site to a Patreon account, allowing attackers to make a logged-in administrator re-link the integration to an attacker-controlled account via a crafted request (CSRF), taking over the site's Patreon integration.

The Patreon WordPress plugin before 1.10.0 does not perform an authorization check on some of its functionality, allowing unauthenticated users to enumerate the names of terms in any taxonomy, including non-public taxonomies that WordPress does not expose on the front end.

The Patreon WordPress plugin before 1.10.0 does not validate a user-supplied redirect destination before redirecting, allowing unauthenticated attackers to redirect visitors to an arbitrary external URL through a crafted link, which is useful for phishing.

The Ukr-To-Lat WordPress plugin through 1.3.5 does not sanitize and escape a term name before using it in a SQL query, allowing users with Contributor-level access and above to perform SQL injection attacks.

The PeachPay — Payments & Express Checkout for WooCommerce (supports Stripe, PayPal, Square, Authorize.net, NMI) WordPress plugin before 1.120.70 does not perform any capability or ownership check before returning an order's secret key in response to an unauthenticated request, allowing anyone to retrieve the key for any paid order and use it to view that order's customer name, email address, postal address and contents.
vp: peachpay — payments & express checkout for woocommerce (supports stripe, paypal, square, authorize.net, nmi)

cves.d: The WP Data Access  WordPress plugin before 5.5.88 does not have authorisation and CSRF checks in one of its actions, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to make the server open connections to arbitrary hosts and ports, including internal ones, and read back the outcome.

The WP User Manager  WordPress plugin before 2.9.20 does not roll back the WordPress account it creates during payment-gated registration when the subsequent payment step fails, allowing unauthenticated users to create functional accounts without completing payment.

The ACF Frontend Admin by DynamiApps WordPress plugin through 3.29.13 does not perform a capability check on one of its form-submission actions before writing submitted values into the site's global ACF options store, allowing unauthenticated visitors to overwrite site-wide option values via a public form.

The ACF Frontend Admin by DynamiApps WordPress plugin through 3.29.13 does not restrict which PHP classes may be instantiated when it deserialises stored post content that is rendered on public-facing pages, allowing high-privilege users such as administrators to inject a PHP object which, given a suitable POP chain in another installed ACF Frontend Admin by DynamiApps WordPress plugin through 3.29.13 or in WordPress core, can be leveraged to achieve remote code execution.

The ThirstyAffiliates  WordPress plugin before 3.12.1 does not check the status or type of the object requested by its link redirect tracking handler, allowing unauthenticated attackers to disclose the destination URLs of unpublished affiliate links and to record fabricated click statistics.

The PickPlugins Product Designer for WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.0.40 does not perform any capability check and its nonce verification is inverted, accepting requests with an invalid or absent nonce while rejecting valid ones, and it does not validate the post the data is written to, allowing unauthenticated users to insert design template data into the metadata of any post on the site.

The Otter Blocks  WordPress plugin before 3.2.3 does not validate that a user-supplied return URL belongs to the site before using it to build the return destination of a Stripe Checkout session, allowing unauthenticated attackers to redirect victims who complete or cancel checkout to an arbitrary external URL.

The Tasty Recipes Lite  WordPress plugin before 1.2.11 does not correctly check user capabilities when creating, renaming and deleting taxonomy terms, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor to add, rename and permanently delete terms in any taxonomy on the site, including categories, tags and navigation menus.

The Salon Booking System  WordPress plugin before 10.31.11 does not prevent users holding its custom salon staff role from assigning arbitrary capabilities to other accounts when editing a customer, allowing them to escalate any account to administrator and take over the site.

The Salon Booking System  WordPress plugin before 10.31.11 does not restrict which user account its salon staff roles may edit through the customers management screen, allowing users with the Salon Staff or Salon Worker role to reset any other user's role, including administrators, to a customer and to overwrite arbitrary profile fields on any account, leading to loss of administrative access and potential site lockout.

The Salon Booking System  WordPress plugin before 10.31.11 does not validate a user-supplied image URL before fetching it server-side and writing the response to a publicly accessible location under an attacker-chosen filename, allowing users with the Salon Staff role or higher to force the server to read internal-only resources and disclose them, and to store a malicious SVG that runs arbitrary scripts in the site's origin for anyone who opens it.

The Salon Booking System  WordPress plugin before 10.31.11 does not restrict one of its REST API endpoints to salon staff, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to retrieve every discount coupon configured on the site, including coupons the administrator has chosen to hide from customers, together with their amounts, validity dates and usage limits.

The Modern Events Calendar Lite WordPress plugin before 7.37.0 does not perform capability, nonce, or ownership checks before returning event booking and attendee data, allowing any authenticated user, including Subscribers, to disclose the names, email addresses, transaction IDs and payment amounts of every booking on the site.

The Modern Events Calendar Lite WordPress plugin before 7.36.4 does not verify that a user is authorized to edit the target post before updating it, allowing authenticated users with the Subscriber role to modify the title, content, and excerpt of arbitrary posts, pages, and custom post types created by other users.

The AI Engine  WordPress plugin before 3.7.9 does not check that the item passed to one of its media actions belongs to the requesting user before converting it to an attachment and permanently deleting it, allowing users with the Editor role and above to delete arbitrary posts of any type, including content they cannot otherwise delete such as navigation menus, block templates and global styles.

The WP Photo Album Plus WordPress plugin before 9.2.11.002 does not properly escape a category navigation value before reflecting it into a JavaScript event handler on its gallery breadcrumb links, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary script that executes in the browser of anyone who follows a crafted gallery link and clicks the breadcrumb, including a logged-in administrator.

The AI Engine  WordPress plugin before 3.7.9 does not verify that the user performing certain AI media management actions owns or is otherwise allowed to edit the targeted object, allowing users with the Editor role or above to modify, or change the type of, arbitrary posts on the site, including content they are not permitted to edit.

The Modern Events Calendar Lite WordPress plugin before 7.37.0, Modern Event Calendar Pro WordPress plugin before 7.37.0 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement, allowing authenticated users with minimal privileges (Subscriber and above) to perform SQL injection attacks.
Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in WP Chill Strong Testimonials strong-testimonials allows Object Injection.This issue affects Strong Testimonials: from n/a through 3.3.12.

Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in Hamid Alinia Login with phone number login-with-phone-number allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects Login with phone number: from n/a through 1.8.77.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Kit Kit (formerly ConvertKit) convertkit allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Kit (formerly ConvertKit): from n/a through 3.4.6.

Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in QuantumCloud Conversational Forms for ChatBot conversational-forms allows Object Injection.This issue affects Conversational Forms for ChatBot: from n/a through 1.5.1.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Arraytics Booktics booktics allows SQL Injection.This issue affects Booktics: from n/a through 1.0.29.

Authentication Bypass by Primary Weakness vulnerability in VideoWhisper.com 2Way VideoCalls and Random Chat webcam-2way-videochat allows Authentication Abuse.This issue affects 2Way VideoCalls and Random Chat: from n/a through 6.1.5.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in IdeaBox Creations PowerPack Lite for Beaver Builder powerpack-addon-for-beaver-builder allows Stored XSS.This issue affects PowerPack Lite for Beaver Builder: from n/a through 1.3.1.
Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in Brainstorm Force OttoKit suretriggers allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects OttoKit: from n/a through 1.1.40.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in NSquared Simply Schedule Appointments simply-schedule-appointments allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Simply Schedule Appointments: from n/a through 1.6.12.35.
Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in ThemeGrill eStore estore allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects eStore: from n/a through 1.6.13.
Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability in HivePress HivePress hivepress allows Code Injection.This issue affects HivePress: from n/a through 1.7.32.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in WPExperts Advanced File Manager file-manager-advanced allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Advanced File Manager: from n/a through 5.4.14.

A flaw was found in Foreman. This vulnerability allows an authenticated remote attacker with low-level read permissions to achieve arbitrary code execution on the underlying server. By manipulating the permitted methods list within the template rendering engine, an attacker can bypass the safemode sandbox isolation and execute unauthorized commands directly on the host system.

A weakness has been identified in hrisikeshpal Blood_Bank_Management_System 1.0.0. Impacted is an unknown function of the file /abs.php. This manipulation of the argument Search causes cross site scripting. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A vulnerability was determined in dext34-morgan Books4Cash up to a8d3e357db75c07ac5ffbadcbaee2aeb4db3e571. This affects an unknown part of the file search.php. Executing a manipulation of the argument Search can lead to cross site scripting. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The code repository of the project has not been active for many years.

A vulnerability was found in alexpasmantier television up to 0.15.9. Affected by this issue is the function Entry::output of the file television/channels/entry.rs. Performing a manipulation of the argument raw results in command injection. The attack requires a local approach. The reported GitHub issue was closed with the label "not planned".

A vulnerability has been found in David-Crty Databasement up to 1.8.1. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/SaveScheduledRestoreRequest.php of the component Scheduled Restore. Such manipulation of the argument schema_name leads to missing authorization. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.8.2 addresses this issue. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component.

A flaw has been found in OpenCATS 0.10.0. Affected is the function processLogin of the file modules/careers/CareersUI.php of the component Career Portal. This manipulation of the argument applyToJobSubAction causes improper restriction of excessive authentication attempts. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. A high degree of complexity is needed for the attack. The exploitability is told to be difficult. The exploit has been published and may be used. Patch name: 1cf4fa3ee9054314b023be79d404078645c22ade. It is suggested to install a patch to address this issue. The project maintainer explains: "Candidates will now need to authenticate each time they access the Career Portal and successfully complete the CAPTCHA as part of that authentication flow. The authenticated candidate identity is now maintained server-side rather than relying on the previous persistent client-side cats…cw cookie mechanism. Application-level rate limiting is deliberately not in scope for this change. In my view, request throttling and brute-force protection of that kind are better applied at the network, reverse-proxy or web-server layer, where they can be configured appropriately for each deployment without OpenCATS having to implement and maintain its own rate-limiting framework. I'll update the online documentation to that effect."

A vulnerability was detected in itsmeravitejak Online-Examination-System up to e6208e630b14657999bbfe4c9912302d2a1e2449. This impacts the function MySQLDB::topicslist of the file exammanger.php of the component AJAX Endpoint. The manipulation of the argument subject results in sql injection. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. This product operates on a rolling release basis, ensuring continuous delivery. Consequently, there are no version details for either affected or updated releases. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A security vulnerability has been detected in itsmeravitejak Online-Examination-System up to e6208e630b14657999bbfe4c9912302d2a1e2449. This affects the function MySQLDB::valid/MySQLDB::getresults/MySQLDB::noresults/MySQLDB::getExams/MySQLDB::latestExamID/MySQLDB::getreport of the file results.php/include/database.php. The manipulation of the argument id/user/topic leads to sql injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. This product uses a rolling release model to deliver continuous updates. As a result, specific version information for affected or updated releases is not available. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A weakness has been identified in itsmeravitejak Online-Examination-System up to e6208e630b14657999bbfe4c9912302d2a1e2449. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file qsdb/usersdb/brandb/topicsdb/subjectsdb.php. Executing a manipulation of the argument query/qtype/sortname/sortorder can lead to sql injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. This product does not use versioning. This is why information about affected and unaffected releases are unavailable. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A security flaw has been discovered in itsmeravitejak Online-Examination-System up to e6208e630b14657999bbfe4c9912302d2a1e2449. The affected element is the function isAdmin of the file admin/admin.php. Performing a manipulation results in missing authentication. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. Continious delivery with rolling releases is used by this product. Therefore, no version details of affected nor updated releases are available. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A vulnerability was identified in makeplane plane up to 1.4.2. Impacted is an unknown function of the component API Endpoint. Such manipulation of the argument X-Forwarded-For leads to reliance on untrusted inputs in a security decision. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

Improper authorization in the ToolGroupResource and RoleAjax REST/DWR endpoints in dotCMS dotCMS 21.02 through 26.06.22-03 on all platforms allows a low-privileged authenticated backend user to self-assign the administrative layout and self-grant the CMS Administrator role, then achieve remote code execution via a crafted OSGi bundle upload whose BundleActivator executes arbitrary shell commands.

ai.summary_en: Today's curated vulnerabilities highlight a significant concentration of critical flaws in web applications and database middleware, where attackers can achieve remote code execution, authentication bypasses, and unauthorized administrative access across platforms like dotCMS, LogicalDOC, and Red Hat Foreman. Network infrastructure remains at risk through a Juniper Junos OS denial-of-service vulnerability and an OpenVPN identity impersonation flaw, while cloud services face threats from hardcoded credentials in Vanus and SSO bypasses in BMC Helix. Additionally, emerging technologies including AI model deployment tools and IoT firmware update mechanisms exhibit severe weaknesses such as code injection, heap corruption, and improper certificate validation that could compromise system integrity and privacy.
ai.summary_zh: 今日精选漏洞显示，Web 应用和数据库中间件中集中存在大量关键缺陷，攻击者可利用 dotCMS、LogicalDOC 和 Red Hat Foreman 等平台实现远程代码执行、身份验证绕过及未授权的管理员访问。网络基础设施仍面临风险，包括 Juniper Junos OS 的拒绝服务漏洞和 OpenVPN 的身份冒充缺陷；云服务则因 Vanus 中的硬编码凭据及 BMC Helix 的单点登录绕过而受到威胁。此外，包括 AI 模型部署工具和物联网固件更新机制在内的新兴技术也暴露出代码注入、堆内存损坏及证书验证不当等严重弱点，可能危及系统完整性与隐私。

items.reason_en: Epic Games Unreal Engine's insecure default configuration for the LaunchURL Blueprint node permits all URL schemes, which can lead to local file access or malicious redirects on Windows desktop systems.
items.reason_zh: Epic Games Unreal Engine 的 LaunchURL Blueprint 节点存在不安全的默认配置，允许使用所有 URL 协议，可能导致在 Windows 桌面系统上发生本地文件访问或恶意重定向。

items.reason_en: An incorrect DBus policy in Ubports' lomiri-upload-manager allows any local user to read arbitrary files as root, severely compromising mobile device privacy and integrity.
items.reason_zh: Ubports 的 lomiri-upload-manager 中存在错误的 DBus 策略，允许任何本地用户以 root 权限读取任意文件，严重损害移动设备的隐私和完整性。

items.reason_en: SWUpdate improperly validates X.509 certificates during firmware chain building, enabling attackers with sibling intermediate keys to push malicious updates to embedded devices.
items.reason_zh: SWUpdate 在固件链构建过程中未正确验证 X.509 证书，使拥有同级中间密钥的攻击者能够向嵌入式设备推送恶意更新。

items.reason_en: Vanus event streaming platform contains hardcoded default credentials that grant unauthenticated remote attackers full cluster-admin access to manage namespaces and tokens.
items.reason_zh: Vanus 事件流平台包含硬编码的默认凭据，可使未经身份验证的远程攻击者获得完整的集群管理员权限，从而管理命名空间和令牌。

items.reason_en: BMC Helix Network Management suffers from an authentication bypass when SAML SSO is configured, allowing attackers to log in as the local administrator with any password.
items.reason_zh: 当配置 SAML SSO 时，BMC Helix Network Management 存在身份验证绕过漏洞，允许攻击者使用任意密码以本地管理员身份登录。

items.reason_en: Juniper Networks Junos OS routing daemon contains a NULL pointer dereference exploitable by BGP peers to trigger denial-of-service conditions on critical network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Juniper Networks Junos OS 路由守护进程存在空指针解引用漏洞，BGP 对等体可利用该漏洞在关键网络基础设施上触发拒绝服务状况。

items.reason_en: OpenVPN allows authenticated users to impersonate other identities via crafted certificate subject fields, undermining secure remote access controls.
items.reason_zh: OpenVPN 允许经过身份验证的用户通过构造的证书主题字段冒充其他身份，破坏了安全远程访问控制机制。

items.reason_en: Wukong_HRM features a critical authentication bypass in its ParamAspect middleware, granting unauthenticated attackers full administrative access to sensitive HR data.
items.reason_zh: Wukong_HRM 的 ParamAspect 中间件存在关键的身份验证绕过漏洞，使未经身份验证的攻击者能够完全访问敏感的 HR 数据。

items.reason_en: dotCMS REST/DWR endpoints allow low-privileged backend users to self-assign administrative roles, directly leading to remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: dotCMS 的 REST/DWR 端点允许低权限后端用户自分配管理员角色，直接导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: GetGrav's OAuth plugin provisions accounts with unsalted MD5 passwords and deterministic usernames, facilitating mass account takeovers via leaked credential databases.
items.reason_zh: GetGrav 的 OAuth 插件使用无盐 MD5 密码和确定性用户名配置账户，使得通过泄露的凭据数据库进行大规模账户接管成为可能。

items.reason_en: LogicalDOC Community Edition allows authenticated users to execute OS commands by injecting malicious Velocity templates into document email subjects.
items.reason_zh: LogicalDOC Community Edition 允许经过身份验证的用户通过将恶意 Velocity 模板注入文档邮件主题来执行操作系统命令。

items.reason_en: Open WebUI's cross-origin message handling flaw enables any website to steal authenticated user session tokens, compromising AI chat platform security.
items.reason_zh: Open WebUI 的跨域消息处理缺陷使任何网站都能窃取经过身份验证的用户会话令牌，危及 AI 聊天平台的安全。

items.reason_en: Arraytics Booktics contains a severe SQL injection vulnerability in its checkout parameters, allowing attackers to extract or manipulate database contents.
items.reason_zh: Arraytics Booktics 的结账参数中存在严重的 SQL 注入漏洞，允许攻击者提取或操纵数据库内容。

items.reason_en: Thimpress LearnPress WordPress plugin deserializes untrusted input during checkout, enabling remote attackers to achieve object injection and arbitrary code execution.
items.reason_zh: Thimpress LearnPress WordPress 插件在结账过程中反序列化不受信任的输入，使远程攻击者能够实现对象注入和任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: QuantumCloud Conversational Forms for ChatBot suffers from deserialization of untrusted data, allowing attackers to inject objects and compromise chatbot integrations.
items.reason_zh: QuantumCloud Conversational Forms for ChatBot 存在反序列化不受信任数据的漏洞，允许攻击者注入对象并破坏聊天机器人集成。

items.reason_en: WhoDB's query editor exposes DuckDB filesystem functions without proper restrictions, allowing authenticated attackers to perform path traversal and read/write host files.
items.reason_zh: WhoDB 的查询编辑器在未受适当限制的情况下暴露了 DuckDB 文件系统函数，允许经过身份验证的攻击者执行路径遍历并读写主机文件。

items.reason_en: Red Hat Foreman's template rendering engine safemode bypass allows low-privileged users to execute arbitrary code on the underlying management server.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Foreman 的模板渲染引擎存在安全模式绕过漏洞，允许低权限用户在底层管理服务器上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: SGLang's video preprocessing allocates unbounded memory by decoding frames at full resolution, enabling remote denial-of-service attacks on LLM inference deployments.
items.reason_zh: SGLang 的视频预处理功能通过全分辨率解码帧分配无界内存，使针对 LLM 推理部署的远程拒绝服务攻击成为可能。

items.reason_en: OpenRefine's get-rows command contains a CSRF flaw that lures users into executing arbitrary Jython facet expressions, resulting in operating system command execution.
items.reason_zh: OpenRefine 的 get-rows 命令存在 CSRF 缺陷，会诱使用户执行任意的 Jython 筛选表达式，从而导致操作系统命令执行。

items.reason_en: YOLOv9's ONNX Metadata Handler suffers from code injection via manipulated argument names, posing risks to edge AI model deployment pipelines.
items.reason_zh: YOLOv9 的 ONNX Metadata Handler 存在通过篡改参数名称导致的代码注入漏洞，对边缘 AI 模型部署流水线构成风险。

items.reason_en: AUTOMATIC1111 stable-diffusion-webui contains a code injection vulnerability in its model instantiation component, allowing remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted targets.
items.reason_zh: AUTOMATIC1111 stable-diffusion-webui 的模型实例化组件存在代码注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者通过构造的目标执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: snac2's JSON lexer contains a heap-based buffer overflow triggered by crafted escape sequences, enabling remote memory corruption via ActivityPub endpoints.
items.reason_zh: snac2 的 JSON 词法分析器存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，由构造的转义序列触发，可通过 ActivityPub 端点实现远程内存损坏。

items.reason_en: cgltf's accessor unpacking function performs unchecked sparse index operations, allowing attackers to corrupt heap memory through malicious glTF/GLB files.
items.reason_zh: cgltf 的 accessor 解包函数执行未检查的稀疏索引操作，允许攻击者通过恶意的 glTF/GLB 文件损坏堆内存。
